changes.comment: Fix an issue where the Rush daemon could report success for a build whose warnings fail it. After a run with such warnings, the next run of that operation used its incremental command, which might not report the warnings again, e.g. that of a linter that caches which files passed. The next run of that operation now uses its initial command, so the build keeps failing until the warnings are fixed, as `rush build` does without the Rush daemon.
